If it’s purely selfish (e.g., you’re avoiding responsibility), it may be seen as *l’matah* (negative). 5. ***Tzedakah* (Righteousness) in Action** - If you’re doing this out of love for the child (e.g., you feel the new babysitter isn’t a good fit), that’s positive.
